newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia says no airport announcement Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Australia says no airport announcement Thursday.

text.p: The Australian government plans to make no announcement on Wednesday or Thursday on the selection of bidders for three airports that it is currently offering for sale, a government spokesman said on Wednesday.
Asked whether there would be an announcement on those days, a spokesman for Finance Minister John Fahey said "No."
Earlier on Wednesday Fahey said the government was close to choosing buyers for 50-year leases for the airports -- those at Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth.
